comparison.objective: Fill a three-day dose tray according to a time-based color regimen.
comparison.physical_skill: Schedule reasoning, repeated cup grasping, and accurate compartment placement.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one cup occupies each due dose slot and no other slots, according to the stated blue and red schedules; geometric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Regimen interpretation and discrete tray filling are meaningfully different from bimanual hammering, mechanical fracture, and loose-tang recovery.
